basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Platform Engineer | Distributed Systems & Data Platforms | Production-Grade Backend Services
basics.summary: Platform engineer with 13+ years shipping distributed systems, backend services, and data platforms for research, analytics, and production at scale. At LumApps, built event-driven data infrastructure (Pub/Sub ingest, a temporal knowledge graph) that unifies 5+ data silos into one self-service memory layer with a query and write-back contract every consuming system uses. Earlier built large-scale parallel simulation infrastructure on AWS for genetic-algorithm research at EPFL, and shipped high-throughput data pipelines and a distributed templating platform serving 10M+ users at Beekeeper. Python, Java, C++, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS and GCP: performance, reliability, and researcher productivity at scale are the metrics I optimize for.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end, from production AI agent architecture to company-wide governance and sales enablement strategy. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, conversation transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory with a self-service query and write-back contract every agent reads and writes. Event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub and a freshness layer that flags stale facts ground retrieval and cut hallucinations.

Built and deployed a production multi-agent platform on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, with tools exposed as backend services over MCP servers and agent state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. Applied to outbound sales: 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $4M in approved opportunities per quarter; at 25% conversion, $1M in quarterly revenue.

Owned reliability and performance for production systems end to end: technical discovery, eval pipelines, agent tracing (LangSmith), tool-selection tuning, cost-per-request instrumentation, and on-call for global systems. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes, not progress.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer. Owns the problem, designs the solution, ships to prod, and stays accountable to the metric. Built AI-powered products used by millions while growing the engineering team around me.
highlights: Designed and shipped a distributed templating engine, a backend service with APIs powering 15% of all platform assets for 10M+ users. Cut customer setup time 90%: customers go from zero to live in minutes, not days.
Led Search Platform revamp across 3 teams. Redesigned indexing and ranking to surface what users mean to find, not just what they typed. Measurable lift in user engagement.
Ran observability and on-call for global production systems (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io): logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: architecture, infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Engineered real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization algorithms. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.
Built cloud infrastructure and DevOps pipeline from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at the frontier of robotics. Built and scaled Robogen, an open-source platform for the co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms. Foundational AI work that underpins my current LLM and agentic systems craft.
highlights: Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research, work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.

Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Rare research direction where morphology and neural control evolve together through artificial selection.

education.institution: Quantic School of Business and Technology

publications.name: EPFL designs robots through artificial evolution
publications.summary: RoboGen, an open-source platform from EPFL, uses AWS and artificial evolution (AI) to co-evolve robot bodies and brains. To power its demanding, distributed experiments, the project relies on AWS Cloud for dynamic scaling. This allows researchers and students to rapidly design, test, and manufacture the unique, evolved robots in the real world.

publications.name: High-Performance, Scalable URL Shortener
publications.summary: Technical architecture guide demonstrating implementation of enterprise-grade URL shortening service using infrastructure-as-code principles and cloud-native scalability patterns.

publications.name: Your AI Needs a Brain, Not a Better Model
publications.summary: A map of the 12 memory and RAG tools building the AI brain layer: why temporal knowledge graphs beat vector-only RAG, and how to pick the right memory and retrieval stack for agents in production.

publications.name: Agentic AI: Simple ReAct Agent
publications.summary: Technical tutorial series introducing practical implementation of ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) agents, demonstrating how to build autonomous AI systems that combine reasoning capabilities with actionable decision-making for real-world applications.

publications.name: I Built an AI Outbound Agent. Here’s What Actually Worked.
publications.summary: In-depth case study of building and deploying a production AI outbound sales agent, detailing the architecture, implementation, and real-world outcomes that led to 2x open rates and 2x approved opportunities.

publications.name: Drafted, not sent: how I built the second half of an AI outbound agent.
publications.summary: How verification loops, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and draft-before-send patterns keep an autonomous agent from shipping wrong actions to real customers.

awards.title: Appreciation from John T. Chambers (ex-CEO, Cisco Systems)
awards.summary: Recognized for contributions to strategic projects within Cisco's ecosystem

awards.title: TI India Analog Design Contest Winner

projects.name: Anand Creations - Forward Deployed Engineering Practice
projects.description: Independent forward deployed engineering practice, currently the home for the AI products I design, build, and run on my own (SwissNRI, Proplab, PulseView). Open to forward-deployed client engagements: embedding with a team, running technical discovery, and shipping production agentic AI end to end. Take my own products from zero to production: multi-agent systems, RAG grounding, eval pipelines, and observability, the same playbook I bring to any engagement.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence built for my own trading portfolio first, then opened to retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data, with explainability and evaluation built in: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship. Now serving live users on real-time feeds.

projects.name: Proplab - AI for Real Estate
projects.description: Property inspections run on paper, clipboards, and WhatsApp photos. Built an AI-native MVP: a vision pipeline extracts structured signals (room type, condition, defects) from inspection photos, replacing paper-based reports with queryable, AI-readable data; LLM agents then turn those records into marketing-ready listings.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech
projects.description: AI-native cross-border tax and compliance platform for Swiss-Indian families, replacing spreadsheets and expensive advisors. RAG-grounded assistant answers DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax questions in plain language with citations back to the regulation; compliance-first agentic design flags risk before users file, with regulatory guardrails built before features. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction.

_jobApplication.jobDescription:
Role Overview

Citadel Securities is seeking an exceptional Platform Engineer to join our Research Platform Engineering team in Miami, Zurich or New York. Our Research Platform teams are at the forefront of designing and developing the distributed systems, data platforms, and research infrastructure that power large-scale simulations, analytics, and model development across the firm. These systems are critical in allowing researchers to transform data into actionable insights and alpha-generating trading strategies.

Locations

New York, Miami, Zurich

Responsibilities

Design and build distributed platforms and services that support quantitative research, simulations, AI-powered applications, and large-scale analytics workflows
Develop scalable platform services and data systems for ingestion, transformation, storage, and lifecycle management of large datasets
Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and SDKs that improve researcher productivity and self-service capabilities
Improve performance, reliability, and scalability of critical research systems operating in high-throughput environments
Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers to translate research requirements into production-ready systems

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
3+ years of professional software engineering experience
Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or C++, or similar systems-oriented languages
Experience building and operating distributed systems in production environments
Experience designing scalable backend services, APIs, and data-intensive applications
Strong understanding of distributed systems, data-intensive applications, and system design fundamentals
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and modern infrastructure technologies
Experience with technologies such as Kafka, Kubernetes, Spark, Airflow, distributed databases, or similar systems is a plus

About Citadel Securities

Citadel Securities is a technology-driven, next-generation global market maker. We provide institutional and retail investors with world-class liquidity, competitive pricing and seamless front-to-back execution in a broad array of financial products.
